heuristic_paired_scale.status: HEURISTIC, not a confidence interval. A reported paired p fixes only the SE of each paired difference; the arm-level variances, their covariance and the cross-pair correlation are unknown, so no exact interval for a ratio or for D follows, and the direction of any approximation error is not determined. A p reported only as "not significant" bounds the SE from below only.

source_integrity.reading: The two donor papers print identical afternoon table cells for different pairs, yet their figure trajectories for those arms are distinguishable. Figure/table area ratios are 0.95-0.98 for all fasting arms and the afternoon trehalose and glucose arms, but about 0.70 and 0.62 for afternoon isomaltulose and sucrose. That pattern is consistent with the shared cells belonging to the trehalose/glucose pair, but this is an inference from group-curve areas and the table discrepancy remains UNRESOLVED.
source_integrity.shared_donor_cohort: Coordinator-supplied: the 2008 investigators' joint meeting report (Int J Obes 2008 suppl., p. S134, T3:PS.12) links both companion reports to one 10-person four-drink donor. Not independently verified here (the PDF redirected to a publisher sign-in). Consistent with the identical subject descriptions.
